title: Image Overlap
summary: Given two binary square matrices img1 and img2 of size n x n, translate one by sliding its 1s left, right, up, or down any number of units.
statement: Given two binary square matrices img1 and img2 of size n x n, translate one by sliding its 1s left, right, up, or down any number of units. Place the translated image on top of the other and count the number of positions with a 1 in both. Return the maximum count of overlapping 1s.
constraints: Images are equal-size square binary matrices.
Translate one image without rotation and maximize positions where both contain one.
hints: Every aligned pair of one-cells votes for the translation vector between them.
Count differences between coordinates of ones in the two images.
For each one pair increment count[(r1-r2,c1-c2)]; take maximum.
Pairs sharing a translation align simultaneously, so its vote count equals overlap under that shift.
editorial: Pairs sharing a translation align simultaneously, so its vote count equals overlap under that shift.

tests.explanation: A suitable translation aligns three one-cells.
The single one overlaps for score one.
